definitionZh: 快捷键提示标示可用的键盘快捷键，渲染平台对应的按键图形帮助用户发现与记忆。
sourceDefinition: KeybindingHint indicates the presence of an available keyboard shortcut. It renders platform-appropriate key glyphs to help users discover and remember keybindings.
